state.entity_prompt: Rendezvous with Hotel-01 as quickly as possible.

action.instructions: Which entity should actor move toward to follow commander_prompt and entity_prompt? Commander orders override conflicting individual orders. Match names and metadata in entities; capability_ref refers to shared capabilities when present. HP means current health. equipment_remaining counts unused items. Choose one offered entity. The game finds a legal route to an unoccupied tile adjacent to it. Moving spends 1 AP, then you choose again with updated actor state. Other entities remain still during this navigation evaluation.
